searchText: Have you been following Arbitrum? It's coming with all the usual dev tooling, including things like Alchemy, and Etherscan is going to bring their explorer to it in the near future it definitely has good UX too from using it on testnet, it's pretty much just like using L1 itself in terms of experience, except with less fees and faster when there is a sequencer. yes, waiting for it to ripe It's kind of a chicken and egg problem though isn't it? For it to ripe you need developers supporting it 😛 Fortunately Arbitrum doesn't seem to be having problems getting people on board, there's a lot of excitement yea, there are many potential future solutions, whoever makes it easy to use will be used i guess 🙂 and whoever makes it easy to hack / attack will be hacked 😄
